heroHeadline: HHS and ARPA-H Launch SURPASS Program to Accelerate Gene Therapy Trials with AI
heroSubtitle: September 30, 2026: HHS and ARPA-H have launched the SURPASS program, leveraging artificial intelligence to accelerate and expand clinical trials — with potential to significantly shorten development timelines for gene therapies including CRISPR-based treatments. Yesterday, UniQure's AMT-130 demonstrated durable Huntington's disease slowdown at four years, the longest durability data yet for any Huntington's gene therapy.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, MHRA, NIH, peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, NEJM, Cell), ClinicalTrials.gov, and major science outlets. Clinical data reflects published peer-reviewed results only.
